The456 frozen definitions use identity bridges; no PCA is estimated. Any future data-derived projection must be fitted inside its training boundary.

extension_after_first_passing_level.trigger: The256k level is the first individual full-bank screen to pass;128k fails. Two successive passing levels remain required.
extension_after_first_passing_level.frozen_proposals: same full-vector joint128 global and reservoir-local guides
extension_after_first_passing_level.segments: First absolute stop320000 of640000 total sweeps; verify four atomic pauses, then resume unchanged budget/source/RNG to640000. Each process invocation retains its7200s and6.4GB-anon caps.
extension_after_first_passing_level.fallback: If the larger trace hits the existing memory cap, preserve last checkpoints and resume only two independent chains at a time; do not change any chain kernel, budget or RNG state.

resource_policy.reason: A production fork worker was OOM-killed despite the short two-worker preflight. Short feasibility timings do not establish long-run headroom.
resource_policy.restart: retain completed verified chains and rerun missing chains from their original fresh seeds; no partial chain continuation unless exact full state is checkpointed
resource_policy.budget_status: caps and actual unsuccessful costs must be reported; no convergence gate may be waived
resource_policy.cached_matrix_condition: Only the reloaded, cryptographically verified matrix/augmentation cache that passed four chains of 5000 sweeps, aggregate PSS 4838922 KiB, with an environment-anon cap of 6400000000 bytes. Construction environments are excluded and forecasts require the matching original bank.
resource_policy.exact_within_chain_recovery: Supported after478 passing source/installed assertions and fresh-process parity. Same complete Markov/RNG state, runtime/source/kernel/full-budget identity; 4000-sweep checkpoints. Paused or observed partial states do not qualify a posterior.
